selected_observations.excerpt: Term: 24 months. The agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the then-current term ends.

selection_rationale: Auto-renewing term with open 2025-Q1 billing supports in-force status absent termination notice.
known_missing_information: No record of non-renewal notice; auto-renewal cycle count not computed.
